source_caption:
Decoy Dan Plum is based on Dan Schrack. Much like in the film, Schrack only found out about the full extent of his role during his first sting and was involved in the final operation shown in the film. Since then Dan has pivoted to journalism and is a reporter for 13WHAM in New York.

To portray Plum as a “musical theater kid” Skyler Gisondo worked with a vocal coach to have the natural register of his voice be a little bit higher so it didn’t seem as comical of a reach when he went to the decoy voice.

source_details.title: Primetime
source_details.synopsis: Primetime is a 2026 American psychological crime thriller film written by Ajon Singh and directed by Lance Oppenheim. It dramatizes the production of the reality television series To Catch a Predator (2004–2007); Robert Pattinson portrays its host Chris Hansen, an NBC journalist who works with the vigilante group Perverted-Justice to catch child predators in sting operations. Merritt Wever, Skyler Gisondo, Matthew Maher and Phoebe Bridgers appear in supporting roles. Oppenheim, who had previously directed documentaries, conceived Primetime as his first narrative feature film after his wife hired Hansen to record a Cameo video for him in 2024.
